infobox.leads to: All for the Show - Death from Above

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All for the Show - Heroism is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Every gladiator puts on a show. The crowd needs to feel it. Drama! Suffering! A surge of emotions! And what works better for that than fear for their favorite fighter? Nothing. So come on, learn to make yourself the hero. Take a few hits, then win."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 5 enemies while suffering from light or heavy bleeding

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 60,000 Roubles
- 25 GP coins
